title: Terminal and Orbit Anew
author: Bram Coldharbour
blurb: Bram Delacroix, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
